prereg.question: Measured on hallHpAuc in the R2 regime, does the Grinder's 2s root capture add value ON TOP OF contact damage alone — i.e. is the rooted Grinder resolvably better than the identical Grinder with grind.rootMs 0?
prereg.sigmaSource: hallHpAuc paired delta sd measured in the R2 regime by the registered regime-r2-adoption family (24,000 runs, n=3000/cell, 18/18 gates PASS): ~0.87 (maze A) / ~1.41 (maze B). Maze B is the binding constraint. Reused identically by fusion-r2-grinder, steam-vent-retune and the sibling grinder-r3-worth family. Note this sigma was measured for a FUSION-vs-CONTROL contrast; both arms here are the same fusion differing in one dial, whose paired sd is likely SMALLER, so sizing on it is conservative.

regime.label: R2
regime.justification: R2 carried unchanged from grinder-r3-worth and regime-r2-adoption so the two r3 families are directly comparable. Same reasons: R1 stops at wave 8 and never sees the elites at 9-10, and R1's maze-A ceiling was nearly blind to the defence getting better, the only direction a successful mechanic can move it.
regime.scopeLimit: FOUR limits. (1) THE CONTROL ARM HERE IS NOT THE TWO-INGREDIENT CONTROL. It is the Grinder itself with grind.rootMs 0 — a fused structure with contact damage and no root. A verdict from this family says nothing about whether the Grinder is worth its ingredients; that is grinder-r3-worth. Anyone quoting a delta from this family must quote it as 'root vs no-root', never as 'Grinder vs control'. (2) R2's terminal measures are floor-censored and BARRED; hallHpAuc is exempt as an integral over waves played. (3) The CROSS-POLICY GATE IS EMPTY — only scripted-v1 exists — so every verdict here is provisional on it. (4) This family isolates rootMs at its shipped 2000 only; it is not a duration ladder and cannot speak to the shape of the dose-response.

prereg.decisionRule:
Paired delta, grinder-rooted minus control (where control = the same fusion with grind.rootMs 0), on hallHpAuc, per maze.

PASS (the root earns its place): delta > 0 AND BH-adjusted q < 0.05 across the declared family of 12 AND the exact sign test agrees in direction AND the verdict survives hang-imputation at the cell minimum. Passing on EITHER maze is sufficient, consistent with the sibling family and Philip's 2026-08-04 ruling.

FAIL (the root is dead weight or harmful): delta < 0 under those same gates on either maze with no PASS on the other. A FAIL is actionable: it means grind.rootMs should be reconsidered, since the contact damage would be carrying the structure alone.

UNRESOLVED: anything else — and unlike a fusion-worth question, UNRESOLVED here is itself informative, because it would mean a shipped mechanic cannot be shown to do anything at the project's own standard n.

SPLIT-HALF IS DECLARED UNINFORMATIVE AND IS NOT A GATE: with 2 arms splitForMetric ranks a two-value scale. Reported for the record only.

MONOTONICITY RULE: not applicable — one non-control arm, no ordering to disqualify on.

CROSS-POLICY GATE NOT MET: only scripted-v1 exists; every verdict here is PROVISIONAL on that gate.
prereg.whatWouldRefute: A delta whose BH-adjusted q exceeds 0.05 on both mazes refutes the claim that the root capture contributes anything measurable on top of contact damage, and would mean the 2026-08-29 write-ups overstated it. A resolvably negative delta refutes the mechanic outright and makes grind.rootMs a removal candidate. Because the ad-hoc n=144 estimate of this very contrast was +0.094 (maze A) and +0.048 (maze B), both far below that n's detection floor, a null here is a genuinely expected outcome and must not be explained away.
prereg.notes:
WHY THIS FAMILY EXISTS. The 2026-08-29 session shipped TWO mechanics together — root capture and contact damage — and the review docs credited the root with part of the improvement. The n=144 decomposition put the root's marginal contribution at +0.094 (maze A) and +0.048 (maze B) against detection floors of ~0.203 and ~0.329: both unresolvable, so that credit was not evidence. This family tests it directly at the project's own standard n instead of inferring it from a difference of two vs-control deltas.

EXPECTATION, STATED IN ADVANCE: honestly uncertain, leaning null. The point estimates are small and positive on both mazes but were far below the floor that produced them. A PASS would vindicate the mechanic; an UNRESOLVED or FAIL would mean contact damage is doing the work and the root is decoration, which is a live and acceptable outcome.

ARM NAMING. The rootMs-0 arm is named 'control' because analyze.mjs keys the control arm on that literal string; it is NOT the two-ingredient control. The scopeLimit above states this at length because a delta from this family quoted without that context would read as a much stronger claim than it is.

familySize 12 spans BOTH r3 families registered together this session (grinder-r3-worth and grinder-r3-root), 2 x 2 mazes x 3 metrics. Each family alone would be 6; the padding is deliberate and matches fusion-r2-grinder's reasoning about not narrowing a session's multiplicity correction by splitting it across small families.

SAMPLE SIZE. 1600 seeds x 2 postGaps = 3200 cells per arm per maze, against nRequired 3121 from stats.js requiredN(1.41, 0.10).
